description: Returns list of payment subtier waivers

parameters.name: subtier_requisition_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the subtier requisition, supports comma separated list

parameters.name: waiver_type
parameters.description: Filters returned waivers by type. Conditional waivers are contingent on payment; unconditional waivers confirm payment received.

items.description: A lien waiver for a subtier tied to a specific subtier requisition (billing period).

id.description: Unique identifier of the subtier waiver. Use as the {id} path parameter for update, cancel, and regenerate operations.

subtier_requisition_id.description: Identifier of the subtier requisition (billing period) this waiver applies to.

subtier_id.description: Identifier of the subtier this waiver belongs to. Use as the {subtier_id} path parameter.

waiver_type.description: Whether the waiver is conditional (contingent on payment) or unconditional (payment confirmed).

created_by.description: Full name of the user who created the waiver.

updated_by.description: Full name of the user who last updated the waiver.

uploaded_by.description: Full name of the user who uploaded the signed waiver document. Null when no document has been uploaded.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the waiver was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the waiver was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

uploaded_at.description: Timestamp when the signed waiver document was uploaded, in ISO 8601 format. Null when no document has been uploaded.

reviewed_at.description: Timestamp when the waiver was reviewed, in ISO 8601 format. Null until reviewed.

reviewed_by.description: Full name of the user who reviewed the waiver. Null until reviewed.

reviewer_notes.description: Free-text notes left by the reviewer, typically explaining a revise-and-resubmit decision.

status.description: Review lifecycle state of the waiver. One of not_submitted, review_pending, revise_and_resubmit, or approved.

attachment.description: The uploaded waiver document, when one has been attached. Null when no document is present.

url.description: Temporary, downloadable URL for retrieving the attachment file.

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded document.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment file.

generated_waiver.description: The Procore-generated lien waiver document sent to the subtier for e-signature. Null until a waiver is generated via the generate/regenerate endpoints.

id.description: Unique identifier of the generated lien waiver.

status.description: Current state of the generated lien waiver document.
